title: Lace Appliqué A-Line Wedding Dress with Tulle Skirt
description:
A romantic A-line gown with floral lace appliqués scattered over a fitted bodice and a full, floaty tulle skirt. Thin straps and a sweep train keep the look light and timeless.
• Material: polyester lace and soft tulle; satin lining
• Lightly boned bodice with built-in cups
• Concealed back zip with covered buttons
• Sweep train, about 40 cm
• Colour: ivory; sizes EU 34–44

title: Long-Sleeve Lace Mermaid Wedding Dress with Open Back
description:
A figure-hugging mermaid gown covered in corded floral lace, with sheer long sleeves and a deep open back finished with a row of covered buttons.
• Material: corded lace over stretch satin lining
• Sheer long sleeves with lace detail
• Open back with covered buttons over a concealed zip
• Court train, about 60 cm
• Colour: ivory; sizes EU 34–44

title: Minimalist Satin Slip Wedding Dress with Cowl Neck
description:
A pared-back bias-cut slip dress in soft satin with a draped cowl neckline and thin adjustable straps. Ideal for civil ceremonies, beach weddings and elopements.
• Material: polyester satin with a light sheen
• Bias cut that skims the figure
• Adjustable spaghetti straps
• Floor length with a small train
• Colour: ivory; sizes EU 34–44

title: Chiffon Wrap Maxi Bridesmaid Dress with Side Slit
description:
A flowing wrap dress in light chiffon with a V-neckline, tie waist and thigh-high side slit. The adjustable wrap flatters many body shapes, making it easy to match a whole bridal party.
• Material: polyester chiffon, fully lined
• Wrap front with self-tie waist sash
• Adjustable spaghetti straps
• Floor length with side slit
• Colours: sage or dusty rose; sizes S, M, L

title: Satin Bridesmaid Dress with Flutter Sleeves and V-Neck
description:
An elegant floor-length satin dress with soft flutter sleeves, a V-neckline and a cinched waist. The blush tone works for spring and summer weddings.
• Material: matte satin, fully lined
• Flutter sleeves and V-neckline
• Concealed back zip
• Floor length
• Colour: blush; sizes XS–XL

title: Off-Shoulder Chiffon Bridesmaid Maxi Dress
description:
A classic off-shoulder bridesmaid dress with a folded neckline, fitted bodice and soft A-line chiffon skirt in a rich burgundy shade for autumn and winter weddings.
• Material: polyester chiffon with satin lining
• Folded off-shoulder neckline with stretch
• Concealed side zip
• Floor length
• Colour: burgundy; sizes XS–XXL

title: Satin A-Line Prom Dress with Lace Bodice and Leg Slit
description:
A show-stopping gown with a lace-appliqué bodice, plunging V-neck and a full satin skirt with a high leg slit. Made for proms, galas and black-tie events.
• Material: satin skirt with lace and mesh bodice; lined
• Plunging V-neck with thin straps
• Concealed back zip
• Floor length with leg slit
• Colour: plum; sizes XS–XL

title: Glitter Tulle Ball Gown with V-Neck
description:
A sparkling ball gown with a fitted V-neck bodice and layers of glitter tulle that catch the light with every step.
• Material: glitter tulle over satin lining
• Fitted bodice with wide shoulder straps
• Lace-up corset back for an adjustable fit
• Full floor-length skirt
• Colour: emerald green; sizes XS–XL

title: Sequin Spaghetti-Strap Evening Gown
description:
A slinky column gown covered in shimmering sequins, with a low V-neckline and delicate spaghetti straps. Effortless glamour for parties and formal dinners.
• Material: sequinned mesh with stretch lining
• V-neckline with adjustable straps
• Slip-on style, no zip
• Floor length
• Colour: champagne; sizes XS–XL

title: Beaded V-Neck Mother of the Bride Gown
description:
A refined floor-length gown embellished all over with beaded and sequinned patterns, with a flattering V-neck and cap sleeves. Elegant for the mother of the bride or groom.
• Material: beaded mesh over soft jersey lining
• V-neckline with cap sleeves
• Concealed back zip
• Floor length
• Colour: silver grey; sizes EU 38–48

title: Two-Piece Trouser Suit for Mother of the Bride
description:
A polished alternative to a dress: a tailored single-button blazer with matching wide-leg trousers in a fresh teal. Wear it with a silk-look blouse for weddings, christenings and garden parties.
• Material: 95% polyester, 5% elastane crepe
• Blazer with notch lapels and front pockets
• Wide-leg trousers with side zip
• Blouse not included
• Colour: teal; sizes EU 38–48

title: Flower Girl Tulle Dress with Lace Long Sleeves
description:
A pretty white dress with a lace bodice, sheer lace long sleeves and a full, layered tulle skirt that twirls beautifully down the aisle.
• Material: lace bodice, polyester tulle skirt, cotton-blend lining
• Sheer long lace sleeves
• Back zip with satin bow
• Ankle length
• Sizes: 2–3 to 10–11 years

title: Flower Girl Dress with Big Satin Bow
description:
A sweet sleeveless dress with a soft tulle skirt and an oversized satin bow at the back, in a gentle dusty blue that suits pastel wedding colour schemes.
• Material: satin bodice and bow, polyester tulle skirt, cotton-blend lining
• Large satin bow at the back
• Back zip
• Knee to mid-calf length
• Sizes: 2–3 to 10–11 years

title: Flower Girl Tulle Dress with Satin Sash
description:
A classic white tulle dress with a satin bodice and a contrasting pink sash tied in a bow at the back. Puffy layers give it a fairy-tale feel.
• Material: satin bodice, polyester tulle skirt, cotton-blend lining
• Removable satin sash with bow
• Back zip
• Ankle length
• Sizes: 2–3 to 10–11 years

title: Pearl and Star Bridal Hair Pins, Set of 12
description:
Delicate hair pins topped with faux pearls and little enamel stars, made to scatter through an updo, braid or half-up style.
• Set of 12 pins: 6 with stars, 6 with pearls
• Material: gold-tone alloy, faux pearls, enamel
• Pin length: 6 cm
• Comes in a small gift pouch

title: Pearl and Leaf Bridal Hair Vine
description:
A bendable hair vine of faux pearls, crystals and metal leaves that can be woven through braids, wrapped around a bun or worn as a headband.
• Length: 50 cm; flexible wire base
• Material: alloy, faux pearls and glass crystals
• Ribbon ends for tying
• Comes in a gift box

title: Soft Tulle Bridal Veil with Metal Comb
description:
A single-tier veil in soft, drapey tulle with a cut edge and a metal comb that slides securely into the hair. Choose a fingertip or cathedral length.
• Material: soft polyester tulle, 300 cm wide
• Lengths: 150 cm (fingertip) or 300 cm (cathedral)
• Metal comb, 7 cm wide
• Steam gently to remove creases

title: Wedding Guest Book with Floral Cover and Gold Pen Set
description:
A keepsake guest book with a floral wreath on the cover and thick pages for wishes, photos and signatures. Two gold-tone pens are included.
• Size: 25 × 19 cm, 80 cream pages (120 g/m²)
• Hardback cover with gold foil lettering
• Includes 2 gold-tone ballpoint pens with stand
• Pages suitable for instant-photo prints

title: Rustic Wooden Card Box with Latch and Cards Sign
description:
A vintage-style wooden chest for collecting cards and envelopes at the reception. The hinged lid closes with a metal latch to keep everything safe until the end of the day.
• Size: 30 × 20 × 22 cm
• Material: stained pine with metal hinges and latch
• Includes a hanging 'Cards' tag
• Reusable afterwards as a keepsake or storage box

title: Warm White LED Fairy String Lights, 20 m, EU Plug
description:
200 warm white micro LEDs on thin copper-coloured wire for draping over beams, arches, backdrops and tables. Eight lighting modes create anything from a steady glow to gentle twinkling.
• Length: 20 m of lights plus 3 m lead cable
• 200 LEDs; 8 modes with memory function
• EU plug with low-voltage adapter
• IP44: suitable for covered outdoor areas
